title: Implement Rand10() Using Rand7()
statement: Implement a uniform random integer generator from 1 through 10 using only a uniform generator from 1 through 7.
explanation: Generate a uniform integer from 1 through 49 using two rand7 calls; accept values 1 through 40 and map them to 1 through 10.
example: rand10() returns each integer 1..10 with equal probability

title: Matchsticks to Square
statement: Determine whether all matchsticks can form a square without breaking any stick.
explanation: The total must divide by four; assign sticks from largest to smallest into four sides without exceeding the target.

title: Ones and Zeroes
statement: Choose the largest subset of binary strings that uses at most m zeros and n ones.
explanation: Count zeros and ones in each string, then update a 2D DP table in descending resource order.

title: Heaters
statement: Find the minimum radius required so every house is within range of at least one heater.
explanation: Sort heater positions and find the nearest heater for each house, taking the maximum nearest distance.

title: Number Complement
statement: Return the bitwise complement of a positive integer using only its significant binary bits.
explanation: Build a mask of all ones through the highest set bit and XOR it with the number.

title: Total Hamming Distance
statement: Sum the Hamming distances over every pair of integers in an array.
explanation: At each bit position, if c numbers have a one and n-c have a zero, that bit contributes c*(n-c) across all pairs.

title: Generate Random Point in a Circle
statement: Generate a uniformly random point inside or on a circle with given radius and center.
explanation: Choose angle uniformly and radius proportional to the square root of a uniform random value to ensure uniform area density.
example: Each returned point lies within the circle; exact point is random

title: License Key Formatting
statement: Format an alphanumeric license key into groups of size k separated by dashes, with the first group possibly shorter and all letters uppercase.
explanation: Remove dashes, uppercase letters, then build groups from the right.

title: Max Consecutive Ones
statement: Return the maximum number of consecutive ones in a binary array.
explanation: Count the current streak of ones and reset it at each zero.

title: Predict the Winner
statement: Determine whether player 1 can achieve a score at least as large as player 2 when players alternately take either end of an array.
explanation: DP stores the maximum score difference a player can force over each interval.
